preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(row, list) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: The input is a list of rows.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(matrix[0]) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: All rows in the matrix have the same length.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(cell, str) and len(cell) == 1 and cell.islower() for cell in row) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the matrix is a single lowercase alphabetical character.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for path in get_all_paths(matrix) if is_palindrome(path)) % (10**9 + 7)
postconditions.description: The return value is the count of all palindromic paths from the top-left to the bottom-right cell, modulo 10^9 + 7.
